Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Yes, in many cases an order can be canceled after it’s placed, but timing matters.

• If the order was placed within the last 24 hours and it is not scheduled to ship today, cancellation is typically possible. • Cancellations are also typically possible if the order is scheduled to ship more than 6 days from now. • If the order is scheduled to ship soon, our team would need to review it. • If the order has already shipped, it can no longer be canceled. In some cases, our team may be able to arrange a package recall for $22 per box.

If you want, send me your order number and the email used at checkout, and I can help with the next step.

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

Once an order has already shipped, it can no longer be changed.

That includes updates like adding items, removing items, changing the shipping address, or canceling the order. If you run into a delivery issue after it ships, contact us as soon as possible and we’ll do our best to help.

If you want, I can also help with what options apply before an order ships.

If your order is canceled and a refund is issued, it will be processed back to your original method of payment. It typically takes about 3 to 5 business days for the refund to appear on your account, depending on your bank or card issuer.

If you’d like to talk through canceling a specific order, you can also call our team at (800) 820-0465. We are available Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.

turns.replyText:
Will I get an email confirmation once the change is made?

Once an order is placed and you’ve received an order confirmation email, the payment has already been processed and the payment method cannot be changed on that order.

A couple of helpful points:

If you got an order confirmation email, that means your payment went through successfully.
Our system will not complete an order if the payment method does not work, so you’re all set for that purchase.
For any future orders, you can choose a different card or method during checkout.

If your question is about a stolen or canceled card after you placed the order, as long as the order went through before you reported the card to your bank, your existing order will still process normally.
